title: Happy red panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#fff4e8'/>
